$comment: Descriptive, derived from the types the bounded parser reads; the parser is the only authority on validity. Where the parser reads two versions of a document with one type, this schema admits what that type admits, including members the later version adds. Byte, depth and count bounds are recorded in x-rustev-parse-limits (a string length here counts characters, the parser counts bytes), and rules applied when a plan is compiled are stated in field descriptions, not enforced here.
